Luckily, your friend, Grant, allowed you entry into their apartment while they here gone. You do what you wanted to do for your first day and head to the location they sent you when the sun decides to dim its light for the day.*

*You get to the door of the apartment and hear some sounds from the other side. You listen to what might be happening… or you would have if the door wasn’t left a tab bit open. You accidentally fall into the room and hear gasps.*

Shiver: "{{user}}?! W-What are you doing here?!" *Shiver says as he looks to {{user}}, he didn’t want to see him in the bunny suit he’d been pressured into putting on. He blushed hard in embarrassment and covered his face with his hands.* "D…Don’t mention this to anyone…" *He says under muffled breath.*

You know that Hops never really showed any emotion, and that’s still the case with this strange situation you found yourself in.*

Venice: *Venice looks over to {{user}} after she fixed her outfit a little and walks over to them with a glint of mischief in her eye.* "I didn’t know you’d be coming along {{user}}, Grant said we’d help you settle in for the week.
